title: A Two-Branch Finite-Field Construction for Regular CSS LDPC Bases
summary: This paper develops a two-branch multiplicative-coset construction for regular Calderbank--Shor--Steane (CSS) quantum low-density parity-check base matrices. For a target column weight $J$ and an even row weight $L$, the method reduces regularity, CSS orthogonality, and same-type 4-cycle exclusion to explicit quotient-coset conditions over a finite field. A normalized exhaustive search for these conditions produces base matrices for several $(J,L)$ pairs, so the construction is not tied to a single degree distribution.
